title: P6 E2E API tests with auth flow
description:
E2E API tests covering full user journeys from MVP_User_Stories.md and MVP_Test_Specification.md.

USER JOURNEYS TO TEST (from user stories):
1. US-AUTH: Login → role-based access → logout → token refresh → session timeout
2. US-ASSET: Create org → add site → add turbine → subsystems → components → soft delete
3. US-INSPECT: Create template → start inspection → fill form → submit → QA review → approve/reject
4. US-TICKET: Raise ticket from defect → triage → assign → in-progress → pending review → close → reopen
5. US-DISPATCH: Set technician availability → mark absence → assign work order → replacement suggestion → accept/decline
6. US-SYNC: Offline changes → push → conflict detection → resolution → pull

TEST CASES FROM TEST SPEC (P0/P1 only):
- TC-AUTH-01: Successful login with valid credentials
- TC-AUTH-02: Login with invalid credentials returns error
- TC-AUTH-03: Session timeout after inactivity
- TC-AUTH-04: Role-based access — role assignment by admin
- TC-AUTH-05: Role-based access — all five roles (Technician, Dispatcher, QA Reviewer, Ops Manager, Admin)
- TC-ASSET-01: Create organization with unique name
- TC-ASSET-02: Create site under organization
- TC-ASSET-03: Add turbine to site with model and coordinates
- TC-ASSET-04: Navigate asset hierarchy org→site→turbine→subsystem→component
- TC-INSPECT-01: Create inspection template with versioned schema
- TC-INSPECT-02: Start inspection from template → fill findings → submit
- TC-INSPECT-03: QA reviewer approves/rejects inspection
- TC-TICKET-01: Create ticket from inspection defect
- TC-TICKET-02: Ticket state transitions (NEW→TRIAGED→ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS→PENDING_REVIEW→CLOSED)
- TC-TICKET-03: Reopen closed ticket
- TC-DISPATCH-01: View dispatcher board with technician availability
- TC-DISPATCH-02: Assign work order to available technician
- TC-DISPATCH-03: Absence marking triggers replacement suggestions
- TC-SYNC-01: Push offline changes → conflict detected → resolution
- TC-SYNC-02: Pull latest data after sync

APPROACH:
- Use vitest + fetch against running Hono app (no real HTTP server needed)
- Seed test database before each suite
- Test full request/response cycles with real auth tokens
- Verify state transitions, data integrity, and role guards
- Files: tests/e2e/ directory with one file per user journey

Error handling audit: added ValidationError(400), ForbiddenError(403) classes, added code property to NotFoundError/ConflictError, fixed global error handler to preserve codes. All routes now use consistent error classes. validate.ts has reusable zod hook and UUID param middleware.

Error handling pattern: NotFoundError extends Error (status 404). ConflictError extends Error (status 409). Both caught by global app.onError handler that checks HTTPException first, then returns {error: message} with status. Input validation via @hono/zod-validator with zod schemas. Validation errors return 400 with details.

Role enum from Prisma schema: TECHNICIAN, DISPATCHER, QA_REVIEWER, OPERATIONS_MANAGER, ADMINISTRATOR. Auth middleware: authMiddleware() extracts JWT user, requireRoles() checks role array. TECHNICIAN can update own status/availability. DISPATCHER manages assignments, dispatch board. QA_REVIEWER approves/rejects inspections, views entity-scoped audit. OPERATIONS_MANAGER views dashboards, reports, audit trail. ADMINISTRATOR full access to admin endpoints, user management.

Test pattern (London School): vi.mock('lib/prisma') at top. Create mock prisma with handlers per model.method (e.g. prisma.ticket.findMany.mockResolvedValue). Build app with new Hono().route('/', route). Test via app.request('PATH', {method, headers: {Authorization: Bearer token}, body: JSON.stringify(data)}). Parse response with response.json(). Use helper to generate JWT tokens for auth. Test files in tests/routes/<name>.test.ts. E2E tests in tests/e2e/<flow>.test.ts.

Merge workflow: (1) git stash || true (2) git merge <branch> --no-edit (3) if conflict in src/index.ts: keep both sides' imports and routes, remove conflict markers (4) git add src/index.ts && git commit --no-edit (5) .beads/issues.jsonl often conflicts too: git checkout --theirs .beads/issues.jsonl (6) npm run build && npm test (7) git push. Never merge without stashing first — .beads/issues.jsonl auto-exports on commit.

Cursor pagination pattern: paginationSchema validates limit (default 25, max 100) and cursor (string). buildCursorQuery(prisma, model, query, cursor, cursorField='id') builds where + take + skip. paginatedResponse(results, hasNextPage) wraps {data, pagination: {next_cursor, has_more}}. All list endpoints use this pattern. Sort by created_at descending by default.

Ticket with state machine (NEW→TRIAGED→ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS→PENDING_REVIEW→CLOSED, CLOSED→REOPENED). WorkOrder with WorkOrderEvidence. AuditLog for tracking changes. TechnicianStatus for availability. SyncEvent for offline sync. All entities have created_at/updated_at, soft-delete models have deleted_at.

src/index.ts is the central route registry. Every agent adds imports and app.route() calls here, causing merge conflicts on EVERY multi-agent merge. Resolution: keep both sides' imports and route registrations, alphabetical order. Consider future refactor to auto-discover routes or separate registration files. Always git stash before merge, resolve index.ts conflict, git add and commit --no-edit.

CRUD route template pattern: import Hono, import prisma from lib/prisma, import authMiddleware/requireRoles from middleware/auth, import paginationSchema/buildCursorQuery/paginatedResponse from utils/pagination, import ConflictError/NotFoundError from utils/errors. List endpoint: parse pagination query, buildCursorQuery, paginatedResponse. Create: findFirst duplicate check → ConflictError, then create. Get by ID: findUnique, null → NotFoundError. Update: similar to create. Soft delete: update deleted_at field. All writes behind authMiddleware(), admin routes behind requireRoles('ADMINISTRATOR').

Agents push to worktree-<task-slug> branches (e.g. worktree-work-orders-crud), NOT to orch/agent-* branches. The orch/agent-* branches are stale from initial spawn. Always check git branch -a --sort=-committerdate for latest branches. Some agents work directly in main worktree without committing (seed data agent). Always verify agent output by checking branch commits before merging.

is_pane_idle() in scripts/orch must match BOTH 'bypass permissions' AND 'accept edits' in CC prompt footer. Different permission modes show different text. Also match 'shift+tab'. Spinner keywords to exclude: Fermenting, Effecting, Sock-hopping, Reading, Searched, Analyzing, Building, Pondering, Boondoggling, Gallivanting, Fiddle-aaddling. When in doubt, use /clear on the pane first to reset stale spinner text.

Sync engine uses dynamic prisma table lookup via entityTableMap for INSPECTION/TICKET/WORK_ORDER/EVIDENCE. Version conflict detection compares client version vs server version. SyncEvent model tracks per-entity sync status.

Report routes in src/routes/reports.ts — 4 endpoints: GET /reports/compliance (inspection compliance metrics + overdue), GET /reports/inspections (status breakdown + avg completion hours), GET /reports/work-orders (status + priority breakdown + avg hours), GET /reports/technician-productivity (per-technician WO + inspection counts). Auth: admin/ops_manager for all, QA_REVIEWER for inspections, DISPATCHER for work-orders + productivity. CSV export via ?format=csv query param. Date range + org/site filters.
